title: Taiwan's Tourism Administration: 12 travel agencies reported personal-data leaks in 3 years
date_note: Date of the Knews article reporting the Tourism Administration's figures; it gives no earlier day for the statement.
org: Taiwan travel agencies (Tourism Administration, Ministry of Transportation and Communications)
geo_basis: Taiwan's Tourism Administration as the source of the statistics; agencies named are in Taiwan
summary: Taiwan's Tourism Administration says 12 travel agencies reported personal-data leaks over the past 3 years, with about 1.55 million records leaked in total and fines of NT$3.65 million. Reports rose from 1 in 2024 to 3 in 2025 and 8 so far in 2026. Per Knews, Yi You Net's member centre suffered an external abnormal network attack on 7 November that leaked part of the historical order contact data of over 690,000 members.
plain: Taiwan's tourism regulator says travel-company data leaks are rising: 12 firms reported leaks in 3 years, about 1.55 million records, including part of the order contact data of over 690,000 Yi You Net members.
exec: Travel firms hold passport and itinerary data; the regulator reports rising leak reports and fines of NT$3.65 million.
action: General advice: customers of Taiwanese travel agencies should be wary of messages that use their booking details and confirm them with the agency directly.
impact: About 1.55 million records leaked across 12 agencies in 3 years, per the Tourism Administration.
